According to the text in "Sustainable recycling of cathode scraps via Cyrene-based separation" (susmat-2020), the first charge capacity for the baseline was 205.6 mAh/g, and the recovered NMC622 was 194.0 mAh/g.

To find the difference, we subtract the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity from the baseline's: 205.6 - 194.0 = 11.6 mAh/g.

So, the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fell short of the baseline's by 11.6 mAh/g.
